security_spec.violation_condition: mseccfg.MML, mseccfg.MMWP/MMAP, and mseccfg.RLB fields are hardwired as RO() (read-only, always 0) in MachineLevel.scala:324-326; the PMP checker logic in PMP.scala:424-457 has zero awareness of mseccfg.MML or mseccfg.MMAP — M-mode unconditionally passes through non-locked PMP rules (passThrough = mode > 1.U at line 424), the pmpcfg.L bit is always treated as 'locked+enforced-on-all-modes', the RW=01 encoding remains reserved rather than decoded as Shared-Region, and no MMAP default-deny policy for M-mode is implemented. The mseccfg value forwarded to the TLB via Bundle.scala:539 is only 2 bits wide (PMM only), so Smepmp-relevant bits cannot even reach the PMP checker.
security_spec.summary: XiangShan hardwires all Smepmp control fields (MML, MMAP/MMWP, RLB) as read-only zero and the PMP checker implements only pre-Smepmp 'M-mode bypasses all unlocked rules' semantics — M-mode has unlimited access to S/U-mode memory with no execution-prevention, no shared-region encoding, and no allowlist policy
